Subject: Mutual action plan orientation — VPC topology & owner matrix

Hi Jessica / Tom —

Thanks for agreeing to run a short MAP orientation to align timelines and owner roles for the private/VPC deployment. The goal here is a compact 6-week evaluation + pilot that gets Terrasys onto a dedicated VPC with KMS integration and an auditable IAM model.

Quick context and asks:
- We (Redwood) will provide a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lists milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria.
- Today I want to confirm primary owners on your side for networking/VPN, IAM/KMS, and app deployment topology so we can seed the MAP.
- Proposed initial milestones: network design sign-off, KMS key provisioning, test deployment (staging), security review, pilot cutover.

Can you confirm:
1) Who on Terrasys owns VPN/VPC peering & firewall rules?
2) Who will own KMS key lifecycle and HSM/KMS audit evidence requests?
3) Any required maintenance windows we should avoid in the next 6 weeks?

Attaching the working MAP workbook and our private deploy checklist. I’ll follow up with a short 30-minute alignment call invite once I have owners.

Action items for Redwood: assign internal owners for connectivity, IAM, and deployment ops (see cc).

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Sr. Solutions Lead — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0173

Attachments: MAP_Terrasys_VPC-topology_v1.xlsx (workbook), redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf (guide)

From: Jessica Perez <jessica.perez@terrasys.io>

Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@bigbox.dev>

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan orientation — VPC topology & owner matrix

Thanks Markus —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers from our side:
1) Networking/VPN/VPC peering owner: Tom Liu (cc'd) — he owns infra and peering with cloud partners.
2) KMS & key lifecycle: I own the KMS side; we use AWS KMS with a custom key rotation policy and have an HSM for vaulting certificates. I'll own the audit evidence requests with support from our security engineering.
3) Maintenance windows: Weekly deploy freeze windows are Tue 02:00–05:00 UTC and Fri 22:00–23:30 UTC. Avoid those.

Tom and I can join the alignment call. For timing, next week on Tue/Thu mornings (PST) works best for us.

Jessica Perez
Director, Platform Engineering
Terrasys

+1 312-555-8122
